name: Happy Set: Lucario & Greninja & Zamazenta & Mabosstiff

releases.name: Happy Set: Lucario & Greninja & Zamazenta & Mabosstiff

description.text:
The Happy Set Lucario & Greninja & Zamazenta & Mabosstiff (宝可梦卡牌 嗨皮组合 路卡利欧&甲贺忍蛙&藏玛然特&獒教父) came out on 16 May 2025 with Fearless Terastal, the second Happy Set after the Pikachu & Clefairy & Turtwig & Gimmighoul set of January. Like the first, it is a box for two to four friends to play together. It held four ready-to-play 60-card decks, built around Lucario, Greninja ex, Zamazenta and Mabosstiff ex, each with a card explaining how it plays, plus a beginner's guide, two battle guides, damage counters and two coins. With the decks came rules for two to four players, a 10-card modification pack for changing a deck after a lost game, a one-card reward pack for the winner and seven Collect 151 event packs to share out. With luck one of the four decks was a holo deck, the same cards in holo, which turned up 1.6% of the time. A Happy Deck (嗨皮卡组) box holding one of the four decks at random came out the same day.

Each card carries a small silhouette of its deck's Pokémon. Its cards are numbered out of 58; four basic Energy, Water, Fighting, Darkness and Metal, print their type code instead of a number.
